Rodina Moskva vs Chelyabinsk: Watch Live Stream Online - Russian Cup Round of 32 15.10.2025

Join us for the live broadcast of the Russian Cup Round of 32 (6th round of the Regions Path) match, where the First League side Rodina Moskva will host Chelyabinsk from the Second League. The winner of this tie will advance to the Round of 16 to face a team from the Russian Premier League.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 15, 2025, 14:00 UTC (17:00 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

Rodina comes into this match as the favorite, a status attributed to their participation in a higher-tier league. The Moscow-based club has confidently navigated the previous rounds of the Cup, defeating Znamya Truda (3-0), Dynamo Bryansk (2-0), and, in a dramatic fashion, Shinnik (1-1, 4-3 on penalties), where goalkeeper Daniil Barinov became the hero by saving two spot-kicks in the shootout. In the First League, Rodina is in the mid-table but has a strong home record, with three wins in their last five matches.

Chelyabinsk has been the surprise package of the current Russian Cup campaign. The team sensationally eliminated the RPL side Fakel with a 1-0 victory. On their way to the Round of 32, Chelyabinsk also overcame Irtysh (2-0), Amkar (1-0), and Ufa (2-1). Chelyabinsk is the leader of their group in the Second League and enters this match on a six-game unbeaten streak across all competitions. The team is known for its resilience and solid defensive organization.

Head-to-Head History

The teams have never met in official matches before, as they compete in different divisions of Russian football. This will be their first-ever encounter.

Rodina Moskva vs Chelyabinsk Prediction

Although Rodina is from a stronger league, an easy game is not expected for the Moscow side. Chelyabinsk has already proven that they are capable of causing upsets and defeating higher-ranked teams.

  • Likely Outcome: A narrow victory for Rodina or a draw in regular time.
  • Total Goals Bet: Considering the knockout nature of the match and Chelyabinsk's well-organized defense, a bet on 'Under 2.5 goals' seems highly probable.
  • Key Factor: Chelyabinsk has shown they are a true 'cup fighter.' Rodina will need to give their all to break down the resistance of a motivated opponent who has already created a major sensation in this tournament.

Tune into the Rodina Moskva vs Chelyabinsk live stream on tutsport.net and follow the cup battles!

Arsenal Tula vs Sokol Saratov: Watch Live Stream Online - Russian Cup Round of 32 15.10.2025

Join us for the live broadcast of the Russian Cup Round of 32 (6th round of the Regions Path) match, where Arsenal Tula will host Sokol Saratov. This clash between two First League representatives promises a tight contest for a spot in the next round of the tournament, where an RPL club awaits the winner.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 15, 2025, 16:30 UTC (19:30 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

Arsenal Tula approaches this cup tie in suboptimal form. The team is currently 11th in the First League and has failed to win in regular time in their last eight Russian Cup home matches (3 draws, 5 losses). In the previous round, the 'Gunners' secured a 3-0 away victory against Volna. Just 10 days ago, the teams met in a league fixture in Saratov, which ended in a 1-1 draw.

Sokol Saratov is also struggling for results in the First League, sitting in 17th place. The team's away form is particularly poor, having lost 5 of their 6 away matches this season. However, Sokol has shown more confidence in the Russian Cup, remaining unbeaten in regular time in their last five away games (2 wins, 3 draws). In the previous round, Saratov defeated the media football club Broke Boys 2-0.

Head-to-Head History

The history of encounters between these teams includes 10 matches, with Arsenal holding the advantage: 4 wins to Sokol's 1, with 5 draws. Notably, 8 of the 10 head-to-head meetings have finished with under 2.5 goals. Their most recent game, on October 5, 2025, ended in a 1-1 draw.

Arsenal Tula vs Sokol Saratov Prediction

Despite the lackluster league form of both teams, bookmakers favor Arsenal due to the home-field advantage. However, considering Sokol's resilient character in cup matches and the recent league draw, an evenly matched contest is expected.

  • Likely Outcome: A draw in regular time.
  • Total Goals Bet: Given the low-scoring history of their head-to-head matches and the high stakes of a cup tie, a bet on 'Under 2.5 goals' appears highly probable.
  • Key Factor: Sokol's extremely poor away form in the First League makes Arsenal the favorite. However, the nature of a cup match and the recent closely contested league game suggest that Saratov has a good chance to put up a fight.

Tune into the Arsenal Tula vs Sokol Saratov live stream on tutsport.net and follow the cup battles!

Morocco U20 vs France U20: Watch Live Stream Online - U20 World Cup 2025 Semi-final 15.10.2025

Join us for the live broadcast of the first semi-final of the FIFA U-20 World Cup 2025 in Chile, featuring the tournament's main revelation, Morocco, against one of the top favorites, France. The winner of this match will advance to the World Cup final, while the loser will compete for the bronze medal.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 15, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

The Morocco national team has become the true sensation of the World Cup. The 'Atlas Lions' have displayed incredibly organized and passionate football, which has carried them to the semi-finals. In the knockout stages, the Moroccans successively defeated South Korea and the powerful USA team. Mohamed Ouahbi's squad is distinguished by the best defense in the tournament and the ability to launch lightning-fast counter-attacks. Reaching the final would be the greatest achievement in the history of Moroccan youth football.

The French national team, after a somewhat uncertain start to the tournament, has gained momentum in the knockout matches. 'Les Bleuets,' boasting a wealth of young talent, overcame Japan and Norway in grueling extra-time victories in the Round of 16 and quarter-finals, respectively. The French are superior to their opponents in individual skill and will aim to dominate possession, but they face the challenge of breaking down the most formidable defense of this championship.

Head-to-Head History

The history of official encounters between these youth national teams is not extensive; however, in friendly matches and youth tournaments, the French have more often emerged victorious. Nevertheless, the current Moroccan team has already proven its ability to rewrite history and ignore the past achievements of its opponents.

Morocco U20 vs France U20 Prediction

Experts and bookmakers give a slight edge to the French team due to their more star-studded lineup. However, the organization and incredible dedication of the Moroccans make them a very dangerous opponent. A tactical and tense battle is expected.

  • Likely Outcome: A narrow victory for France or a draw in regular time.
  • Total Goals Bet: Considering Morocco's defensive solidity and the high stakes of a semi-final, a bet on 'Under 2.5 goals' looks highly probable.
  • Key Factor: The clash between France's attacking potential and Morocco's rock-solid defense. The fate of a place in the final could be decided by a single goal.

Tune into the Morocco U20 vs France U20 live stream on tutsport.net and follow the battle for a spot in the U-20 World Cup final!

Argentina U20 vs Colombia U20: Watch Live Stream Online - U20 World Cup 2025 Semi-final 16.10.2025

Join us for the live broadcast of the second semi-final of the FIFA U-20 World Cup 2025 in Chile, featuring a clash between two South American giants: Argentina and Colombia. This rivalry-fueled encounter will determine the second finalist of the tournament and guarantees the continent at least one medal.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 16, 2025, 02:00 MSK (23:00 UTC October 15).

Match Preview and Team Form

Argentina, the most decorated team in the history of the U-20 World Cup, is confidently marching towards its seventh title. The 'Albiceleste,' managed by Javier Mascherano, are playing an entertaining and attacking style of football. On their way to the semi-finals, the Argentinians won their group and subsequently dealt with opponents from Africa and Asia in the knockout stages. The team boasts one of the best forward lines in the tournament and will aim to dominate from the first minute.

Colombia has been one of the most exciting teams to watch at this World Cup. 'Los Cafeteros' are playing fast, technical, and passionate football. The Colombians also comfortably won their group, and in the knockout matches, they have shown great character and a strong will to win. For Colombia, reaching the final would mean matching their best-ever performance (bronze in 2003) with the chance to surpass it.

Head-to-Head History

The rivalry between the youth national teams of Argentina and Colombia has a rich history, especially within the South American U-20 Championship. Traditionally, Argentina has had the upper hand, but the matches are always tight and hard-fought. The Colombians have caused problems for the 'Albiceleste' on numerous occasions, and the upcoming semi-final promises to be another thrilling chapter in this exciting rivalry.

Argentina U20 vs Colombia U20 Prediction

Experts give a slight edge to Argentina, considering their historical status and more balanced squad. However, Colombia's vibrant and unpredictable style of play could pose a serious challenge for the Argentinians.

  • Likely Outcome: A hard-fought victory for Argentina.
  • Total Goals Bet: Given the attacking style of both teams and the intensity of a South American derby, a bet on 'Both Teams to Score - Yes' seems highly probable.
  • Key Factor: A battle of character and tactics. Argentina will try to control the game, while Colombia will rely on quick attacks and the individual skill of their key players.

Tune into the Argentina U20 vs Colombia U20 live stream on tutsport.net and enjoy a South American football spectacle!
